description: The exile fights Abberath, the Cloven One, at Prisoner's Gate.

description: The exile reaches the Brine King's Reef on the Black Crest and fights the Brine King there.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_brine_king_quest", "locator": "Walkthrough: 'After arriving at the Brine King's Reef, search for Nessa... After finding Nessa in The Brine King's Reef you have to defeat the boss.'"}]

description: Weylam Roth summons from the Black Flag and sails the exile on the Black Crest to the Brine King's reef.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_brine_king_quest", "locator": "Walkthrough, Weylam Roth at the Beacon: 'Of course I'll ferry you to the Brine King's blood reef.'"}]

description: Tarkleigh starts the quest by sending the exile to find the missing Nessa.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_brine_king_quest", "locator": "Quest infobox start 'Speak to Tarkleigh'; Walkthrough: 'Nessa... Please, find Nessa. Bring her back to us.'"}]

description: Sin appears after the Brine King is defeated.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_brine_king_quest", "locator": "Walkthrough: 'After defeating The Brine King Sin will appear'"}]

description: The exile enters Maligaro's Sanctum through portals opened with his Map and kills him there.

description: Sin harvests Maligaro's soul after he is killed.

description: The exile kills Black Death and Maligaro in the Sanctum to take the Black Venom.

description: The Black Venom is delivered to Silk in the Chamber of Sins Level 1.

description: Silk asks the exile to take the Black Venom and rewards the delivery with the Obsidian key.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_web_of_secrets", "locator": "Quest infobox start 'Talk to Silk in Act 7'; Silk: 'Please, will you find him, kill this Black Death, take the eight-leg's venom for me?'"}]

description: Maligaro is killed together with his pet spider Black Death in the Web of Secrets quest.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_web_of_secrets", "locator": "Quest infobox: 'boss1=Maligaro, the Artist', 'boss2=Black Death, Pain Unending'"}]

description: The exile kills the possessed Greust in the Forest Encampment to drive Ralakesh back into the relic.

description: Greust, possessed by Ralakesh as its avatar, is the enemy the exile must kill.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_master_of_a_million_faces", "locator": "Walkthrough: 'Ralakesh ... has possessed Greust... You must kill Greust to defeat Ralakesh.'"}]

description: Eramir starts the quest, translating the relic's inscriptions and urging the exile to destroy the god.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_the_master_of_a_million_faces", "locator": "Quest infobox start 'Talk to Eramir in the The Bridge Encampment'; Eramir: 'Please, I urge you to destroy this god'"}]

description: The exile gathers the seven Fireflies in the Dread Thicket.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_lighting_the_way", "locator": "Walkthrough: 'Search for the Firefly in the The Dread Thicket (Act 7)'"}]

description: Hargan tells the exile where Doedre hides in the Toxic Conduits and gives the reward.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_essence_of_the_hag", "locator": "Walkthrough: 'If you speak with Hargan, he tells you that Doedre can be found somewhere in the Toxic Conduits.'"}]

sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_solar_eclipse", "locator": "Quest infobox: 'boss=Dawn, Harbinger of Solaris'; Maramoa: 'The Sun Orb lies within her temple, guarded by her most ardent devotee... 'The Dawn'.'"}]

description: With both orbs, the exile summons Solaris and Lunaris in the Sky Shrine on the Harbour Bridge and kills them.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_solaris_and_lunaris", "locator": "Intro: 'They can be found in the Sky Shrine in the center of The Harbour Bridge once the Moon Orb and Sun Orb have been retrieved'"}]

description: Sin speaks after the twin goddesses fall, declaring the sun and moon back in their rightful places.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_lunar_eclipse", "locator": "Completion dialogue, Sin: 'Sun and Moon return to their rightful places, leaving our path now clear.'"}]

description: The exile meets Sin at the Quarry, where he burns open the way into the Beast.

description: Sin burns the new entrance into the Beast's corpse at the Quarry.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_recurring_nightmare", "locator": "Walkthrough: 'Meet Sin at The Quarry, where he will burn open a new entrance'"}]

sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_recurring_nightmare", "locator": "Walkthrough: 'I shall apply this fermentation to the weakened membrane'"}]

description: Lilly Roth ferries the exile back to Oriath.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_act_10", "locator": "Intro: 'the exile returns to Oriath, courtesy of Lilly Roth'"}]

description: The exile saves Bannon from Kitava's cultists on the Cathedral Rooftop.

description: Innocence destroys the black gates blocking the Canals with his power.

description: The exile finds Kitava at his Feeding Trough and kills him there.

description: Sin begins the final battle and congratulates the exile after Kitava falls.
sources: [{"source_id": "src_poewiki_an_end_to_hunger", "locator": "Walkthrough, Sin: 'This is it... Go Exile, together we will save humankind!'"}]

description: Innocence, reborn, fights alongside the exile against Kitava.

sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Speak to the Hooded One: 'The Karui are already with us.'"}]

sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_search", "locator": "Speak to the Hooded One: 'We should call upon the Ezomytes and the Maraketh.'"}]

sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_ezomytes", "locator": "Speak to Renly: Renly: 'Our neighbours... in Holten. Thane Wulfric and Lady Elswyth have lost their bloody minds.'"}]

sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_recruit_the_ezomytes", "locator": "Speak to the Hooded One: 'To Ogham, then. Hopefully, they've had time to rebuild.'"}]

sources: [{"source_id": "src_poe2wiki_the_mad_wolf_of_ogham", "locator": "Quest header 'start = Talk to Leitis' / Walkthrough 'Infiltrate the Manor'"}]

description: Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Do you think you are savage enough to face the land of the damned, Marauder?' The Marauder's legacy text names Oriath's chains ('Oriath chained me, made me its slave') but gives no specific crime.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You have betrayed the Grand Arena. Now Wraeclast shall be your audience.. and your foe.' The Duelist's legacy text says he killed a high-born lord in a duel ('That lord sang a different tune with six inches of steel in his guts') and was then called a criminal.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Swift and silent you stole the bounty of others.' The Ranger's legacy text says Oriath called her a 'poacher' and 'thief' and hauled her 'like cargo into exile' (the stated grievance is poaching).

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'Yours is a predatory profession. The business of butchery.' The Shadow's legacy text describes a contract killing ('Silence a big mouth'); the employers toasted the job and the Shadow was shipped into exile.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'When a Daughter strays away from the Light, she makes herself an Orphan.' The Witch's legacy text: 'Had they not taken my home with fire, I would not have taken their children.' The stated act is taking children; no formal charge is named.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'You were once the chosen of God. A Templar. You are now the chosen of Wraeclast. An exile.' The Templar's legacy text: 'They exile me to the land of the damned.' The crime is only hinted at ('only to smite it asunder with one sinful blow'); no specific act is named.

Dominus's character-creation speech: 'But you only gave us Murder and Darkness... Now you will earn your redemption in Wraeclast.' The wiki's own prose (not an in-game quote) says the Scion was exiled for killing her husband on their wedding night.
